en: Black-and-white vintage view over a small European spa town in a valley surrounded by hills and fields. In the foreground stands a large multi-storey bath or sanatorium building with a clock on its facade, surrounded by smaller houses with steep roofs. Further back, more residential buildings spread up the hillside, and on the distant hilltop to the right a prominent church tower dominates the skyline. The lower margin of the image includes a printed caption identifying the place.
